newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 26.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 26.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- President Kim Young-sam, in a public address on Tuesday, apologised to the nation over the involvement of his deputies in the Hanbo loan scandal.
- Kim Hyun-chul, second son to President Kim Young-sam, on Tuesday dropped his libel suits against six opposition party politicians.
- Daewoo officials were the first South Koreans to enter North Korea from Beijing on Tuesday after the government lifted its travel ban to the stalinist state.

- The presidential financial reform committee on Tuesday discussed easing regulations to allow merchant banks to turn commercial, and pursue the integration of the bank, securities, and insurance watchdog bodies.
